summary: Leads page bug fixes after SalesDataTable migration - All tests passed. Verified: 1) FUNNEL column with progress bars showing stage labels (Lead, Meeting, etc.) and progress (1/9, 2/9), 2) Actions dropdown (View Pipeline, Edit Lead, Pause Lead) working correctly, 3) View Pipeline navigates to /sales-funnel-onboarding?leadId=X, 4) Edit Lead opens dialog with pre-filled data, 5) Row click navigates to funnel onboarding page, 6) Card view shows FunnelProgressIndicator, 7) Action dropdown click does NOT trigger row click (stopPropagation works).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing leads data (5 leads)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Leads page bug fixes verified. LeadsTable now uses SalesDataTable with FUNNEL column showing progress bars. All action items (View Pipeline, Edit Lead, Pause Lead) work correctly. Row click navigates to /sales-funnel-onboarding?leadId=X. Card view shows FunnelProgressIndicator. stopPropagation on action dropdown prevents row click.
